description.en: Proofread the selection with Harper, the offline grammar checker.
description.zh-Hans: 使用离线语法检查器 Harper 校对选中的文本。
description.zh-Hant: 使用離線文法檢查器 Harper 校對選取的文字。
description.fr: Relisez la sélection avec Harper, le correcteur grammatical hors ligne.
description.ja: オフライン文法チェッカー Harper で選択テキストを校正します。

subActions.scriptCode:
harper=""
for candidate in /opt/homebrew/bin/harper-cli /usr/local/bin/harper-cli "$HOME/.cargo/bin/harper-cli" "$(command -v harper-cli 2>/dev/null)"; do
  if [ -n "$candidate" ] && [ -x "$candidate" ]; then harper="$candidate"; break; fi
done
jqbin=""
for candidate in /usr/bin/jq /opt/homebrew/bin/jq /usr/local/bin/jq "$(command -v jq 2>/dev/null)"; do
  if [ -n "$candidate" ] && [ -x "$candidate" ]; then jqbin="$candidate"; break; fi
done
if [ -z "$harper" ]; then
  printf '%s' '{"type":"toast","message":"Harper is not installed. Run: brew install harper","style":"error"}'
  exit 0
fi
if [ -z "$jqbin" ]; then
  printf '%s' '{"type":"toast","message":"jq is not installed. Run: brew install jq","style":"error"}'
  exit 0
fi
# The dialect option is stored per action id, so fall back to the sibling actions'
# stored value to keep one setting for the whole extension.
dialect="${OPENCLIP_OPTION_DIALECT:-}"
for action_id in "${OPENCLIP_ACTION_ID:-}" com.openclip.harper.fix com.openclip.harper.check com.openclip.harper.report; do
  [ -z "$dialect" ] || break
  [ -n "$action_id" ] || continue
  dialect="$(defaults read com.openclip.OpenClip "action.${action_id}.option.dialect" 2>/dev/null)"
done
[ -n "$dialect" ] || dialect="american"
lints="$(printf '%s' "$OPENCLIP_TEXT" | "$harper" lint --format json --quiet --dialect "$dialect" 2>/dev/null)"
case "$lints" in
  \[*) ;;
  *)
    printf '%s' '{"type":"toast","message":"Harper could not check this selection","style":"error"}'
    exit 0
    ;;
esac
total="$(printf '%s' "$lints" | "$jqbin" '[.[].lints[]] | length')"
[ -n "$total" ] || total=0
fixable="$(printf '%s' "$lints" | "$jqbin" '[.[].lints[] | select((.suggestions | length) > 0)] | length')"
if [ "$total" -eq 0 ]; then
  printf '%s' '{"type":"toast","message":"Harper found no issues","style":"success"}'
  exit 0
fi
if [ "$fixable" -eq 0 ]; then
  "$jqbin" -n --arg n "$total" '{type:"toast",message:("Harper found \($n) issue(s) it cannot fix automatically"),style:"info"}'
  exit 0
fi
printf '%s' "$lints" | "$jqbin" -j --arg text "$OPENCLIP_TEXT" '
  def edit:
    .suggestions[0] as $s
    | if   ($s | startswith("Replace with: “")) then { s: .span.char_start, e: .span.char_end, r: ($s | ltrimstr("Replace with: “") | rtrimstr("”")) }
      elif ($s | startswith("Insert “"))        then { s: .span.char_end,   e: .span.char_end, r: ($s | ltrimstr("Insert “")        | rtrimstr("”")) }
      elif ($s == "Remove error")               then { s: .span.char_start, e: .span.char_end, r: "" }
      else empty end;
  [.[].lints[] | select((.suggestions | length) > 0) | edit]
  | sort_by(.s)
  | reverse
  | reduce .[] as $edit (($text | explode); .[0:$edit.s] + ($edit.r | explode) + .[$edit.e:])
  | implode
'

for candidate in /opt/homebrew/bin/harper-cli /usr/local/bin/harper-cli "$HOME/.cargo/bin/harper-cli" "$(command -v harper-cli 2>/dev/null)"; do
  if [ -n "$candidate" ] && [ -x "$candidate" ]; then harper="$candidate"; break; fi
done

for candidate in /usr/bin/jq /opt/homebrew/bin/jq /usr/local/bin/jq "$(command -v jq 2>/dev/null)"; do
  if [ -n "$candidate" ] && [ -x "$candidate" ]; then jqbin="$candidate"; break; fi
done
if [ -z "$harper" ]; then
  printf '%s' '{"type":"toast","message":"Harper is not installed. Run: brew install harper","style":"error"}'
  exit 0
fi
if [ -z "$jqbin" ]; then
  printf '%s' '{"type":"toast","message":"jq is not installed. Run: brew install jq","style":"error"}'
  exit 0
fi
# The dialect option is stored per action id, so fall back to the sibling actions'
# stored value to keep one setting for the whole extension.
dialect="${OPENCLIP_OPTION_DIALECT:-}"
for action_id in "${OPENCLIP_ACTION_ID:-}" com.openclip.harper.fix com.openclip.harper.check com.openclip.harper.report; do
  [ -z "$dialect" ] || break
  [ -n "$action_id" ] || continue
  dialect="$(defaults read com.openclip.OpenClip "action.${action_id}.option.dialect" 2>/dev/null)"
done
[ -n "$dialect" ] || dialect="american"
lints="$(printf '%s' "$OPENCLIP_TEXT" | "$harper" lint --format json --quiet --dialect "$dialect" 2>/dev/null)"
case "$lints" in
  \[*) ;;
  *)
    printf '%s' '{"type":"toast","message":"Harper could not check this selection","style":"error"}'
    exit 0
    ;;
esac
total="$(printf '%s' "$lints" | "$jqbin" '[.[].lints[]] | length')"
[ -n "$total" ] || total=0
printf '%s' "$lints" | "$jqbin" -c '
  def suggestions_line:
    (.suggestions | map(if startswith("Replace with: “") then "“" + (. | ltrimstr("Replace with: “")) else . end))
    | if length > 0 then "\n   Suggested: " + join(", ") else "" end;
  [.[].lints[]] | sort_by(.span.char_start) as $found
  | ($found | length) as $n
  | if $n == 0 then
      { type: "toast", message: "Harper found no issues", style: "success" }
    else
      { type: "copy",
        value: ("Harper found \($n) issue" + (if $n == 1 then "" else "s" end) + ":\n\n"
                + ([$found[] | "\(.line):\(.column) · \(.kind)\n   \(.message)" + suggestions_line] | join("\n\n"))) }
    end
'

jqbin=""
for candidate in /usr/bin/jq /opt/homebrew/bin/jq /usr/local/bin/jq "$(command -v jq 2>/dev/null)"; do
  if [ -n "$candidate" ] && [ -x "$candidate" ]; then jqbin="$candidate"; break; fi
done
if [ -z "$jqbin" ]; then
  printf '%s' '{"type":"toast","message":"jq is not installed. Run: brew install jq","style":"error"}'
  exit 0
fi
word="$(printf '%s' "$OPENCLIP_TEXT" | tr -d '[:space:]')"
if [ -z "$word" ]; then
  printf '%s' '{"type":"toast","message":"Select a single word to add to your dictionary","style":"error"}'
  exit 0
fi
dictionary="$HOME/Library/Application Support/harper-ls/dictionary.txt"
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$dictionary")" 2>/dev/null
[ -f "$dictionary" ] || : > "$dictionary"
if grep -qxF "$word" "$dictionary" 2>/dev/null; then
  "$jqbin" -nc --arg w "$word" '{type:"toast",message:("“\($w)” is already in your Harper dictionary"),style:"info"}'
  exit 0
fi
if [ -s "$dictionary" ] && [ -n "$(tail -c 1 "$dictionary")" ]; then printf '\n' >> "$dictionary"; fi
printf '%s\n' "$word" >> "$dictionary"
"$jqbin" -nc --arg w "$word" '{type:"toast",message:("Added “\($w)” to your Harper dictionary"),style:"success"}'

jqbin=""
for candidate in /usr/bin/jq /opt/homebrew/bin/jq /usr/local/bin/jq "$(command -v jq 2>/dev/null)"; do
  if [ -n "$candidate" ] && [ -x "$candidate" ]; then jqbin="$candidate"; break; fi
done
if [ -z "$jqbin" ]; then
  printf '%s' '{"type":"toast","message":"jq is not installed. Run: brew install jq","style":"error"}'
  exit 0
fi
word="$(printf '%s' "$OPENCLIP_TEXT" | tr -d '[:space:]')"
if [ -z "$word" ]; then
  printf '%s' '{"type":"toast","message":"Select a single word to remove from your dictionary","style":"error"}'
  exit 0
fi
dictionary="$HOME/Library/Application Support/harper-ls/dictionary.txt"
if [ ! -f "$dictionary" ] || ! grep -qxF "$word" "$dictionary" 2>/dev/null; then
  "$jqbin" -nc --arg w "$word" '{type:"toast",message:("“\($w)” is not in your Harper dictionary"),style:"info"}'
  exit 0
fi
remaining="$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/harper-dictionary.XXXXXX")" || exit 1
grep -vxF "$word" "$dictionary" > "$remaining" 2>/dev/null
grep_status=$?
if [ "$grep_status" -gt 1 ]; then
  rm -f "$remaining"
  "$jqbin" -nc --arg w "$word" '{type:"toast",message:("Could not remove “\($w)” from your Harper dictionary"),style:"error"}'
  exit 0
fi
cat "$remaining" > "$dictionary" && rm -f "$remaining"
"$jqbin" -nc --arg w "$word" '{type:"toast",message:("Removed “\($w)” from your Harper dictionary"),style:"success"}'
